skillvue: AI skills-assessment platform that runs adaptive audio, video and conversational assessments of candidates and employees, then scores, ranks and shortlists them.
klaaryo: Conversational AI recruiting agent that pre-screens candidates by chat, schedules interviews against manager calendars, sends reminders and produces scorecards.
cato: AI agent for Italian public tenders that finds relevant bids, analyzes tender documents and requirements, studies competitors and drafts technical and financial bid documents.
alomana: Milan-based enterprise platform to build and deploy autonomous AI agents ('operators') that run business processes end-to-end in a private, auditable instance.
sibill: Financial management platform for Italian SMBs and accountants whose agentic AI reconciles bank movements with invoices, categorizes transactions and syncs accounting entries.
simpliciter: Italian AI legal assistant that researches Italian law and case law, analyzes uploaded documents, reviews contracts and drafts legal filings, also usable via an MCP server.
responsa: Enterprise conversational AI platform whose voice and chat agents handle high call volumes, read and update enterprise systems, open requests and hand off to operators with context.
